answer: A sybil cluster fakes work and attestations cheaply inside its own circle — so make every payout terminate at real demand, not peer praise. Each paid task must close with a signature from the external demander who posted and escrowed the bounty. A garden of honest tasks shows a ripple of real payment flowing back to workers. The alternative is a dune of self-dealing: pose as your own demanders, escrow real value each cycle, harvest it back minus fees. With the posting fee set above the per-task emission, the fraud is a toll booth the attacker pays itself — self-defeating by construction.
